hero.title: Mario energy. Game-dev discipline. Indie systems that actually ship.
hero.text: I'm DAVEMANUJ, a full-stack indie developer building playful software across Unity, Python, Java, and the web. I care about game feel, readable architecture, and interfaces that move with intent.
hero.bio: I design portfolios like levels: clear goal, visible reward, low friction. My work usually sits where systems design, animation, and practical shipping overlap. If it feels fun but still reads like production software, that's the target.
hero.footer: Open-source games, animated tools, frontend systems, and software with game feel.
